scope: Current visible attack damage primitives; not future monster AI or an authenticated game checkpoint
contracts: AttackIntent.DamageCalc() returns current unmodified decimal attack base; GetSingleDamage applies all source damage hooks before integer truncation and nonnegative clamp.
SingleAttackIntent and MultiAttackIntent labels use that modified per-hit value; MultiAttackIntent separately displays Repeats.
Observed source base_damage and repeats remain distinct from final displayed total; never invert rounded Weak/Vulnerable labels.
Fallback execution and refresh apply monster/player damage modifiers to retained base exactly once, including visible powers applied after capture.
Missing base telemetry on a powered attack and inconsistent base/repeats/display values fail closed; source-free unmodified legacy fixtures remain compatible.
Only declared current intent fields enter imported visible metadata; oracle/debug/future fields are omitted.
